_meta.note: Codes whose MEANING requires generation resolution (join edge: code-meaning pipeline invokes identifier pipeline). DATA ONLY. Miele's generation join is MODEL RANGE + SERIAL YEAR, not a product number.

needsGeneration.resolveVia: model range (G7xxx=new, G1-6xxx=old) + SERIAL YEAR for G5xxx (>=2019 Discovery = new)

meanings.DW_G1_G6_OLD (G 1xxx-G 6xxx): drain pump blocked / water flowing back

needsGeneration.note: SOLE confirmed generation-dependent Miele code. 3-digit legacy G### predates the split.

identifierTypeByManufacturer.ELECTROLUX: PNC + ELC (distinct product number) - identifier mostly for PARTS; modern meaning independent
identifierTypeByManufacturer.WHIRLPOOL: 12NC (distinct commercial code); PREFIX encodes platformLineage -> resolves F02 code meaning
identifierTypeByManufacturer.MIELE: MODEL + SERIAL(year) - NO distinct consumer product-number; generation (F11) resolved by model-range + serial-year
identifierTypeByManufacturer.conclusion: The identifier LAYER generalises, but the identifier TYPE varies (PNC vs 12NC vs model+serial-date). canonicalIdentifiers[] with a 'type' field already supports all three.
